existing.description: The ANU Vice-Chancellor's International Achievement Award is an Australian National University award whose stated objective is to attract a diverse range of academically capable overseas students to enrol in undergraduate and postgraduate coursework programs at ANU, funded by the University. ANU publishes the value as 20% off first-year tuition fees, with the tuition scholarship applied towards tuition at the start of each semester for the one year of the award. It is restricted to residents of China (including Taiwan, Hong Kong SAR and Macau SAR), Japan, Mongolia, the Republic of Korea and the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, and excludes the Doctor of Medicine and Surgery (MChD) and the Master of Digital Transformation and Entrepreneurship (MDTE). Recipients are responsible for the costs of books, study materials, accommodation and all other costs of study.
eligibility: You are a new commencing student, or a continuing student who has received an offer of admission to a higher AQF level of studies.

You hold residential status in one of the following Countries or Regions: China (including Taiwan, Hong Kong SAR and Macau SAR), Japan, Mongolia, Republic of Korea, or The Democratic People's Republic of Korea.

You meet the minimum academic entry requirements: undergraduate applicants a Selection Rank of 85 (or equivalent as determined by the University) or above, or postgraduate applicants a minimum GPA of 5.5 (or equivalent).
You are not the recipient of an external sponsorship that covers all or part of your tuition fees at the University.

You acknowledge that the award can be offered only once at each level of study, except where you progress from an undergraduate degree (AQF Level 7) to a one-year Honours program (AQF Level 8), or accept a packaged offer such as a Graduate Certificate leading to a Master's degree.
Your program is an eligible program, excluding the Doctor of Medicine and Surgery (MChD) and the Master of Digital Transformation and Entrepreneurship (MDTE).
Study level: Undergraduate/Bachelor, Honours, Postgraduate/Masters and Graduate certificate. Selection basis: academic merit.
existing.eligibility_summary: The award is available to an international student who is a new commencing student, or a continuing student with an offer of admission to a higher AQF level, who holds residential status in China (including Taiwan, Hong Kong SAR and Macau SAR), Japan, Mongolia, the Republic of Korea or the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, meets the minimum academic entry requirements (Selection Rank of 85 or equivalent for undergraduate, minimum GPA of 5.5 or equivalent for postgraduate), is not the recipient of an external sponsorship covering all or part of their tuition fees at ANU, and accepts that the award can be offered only once at each level of study.
benefits: No separate scholarship application: all eligible students applying for admission to commence at the University are considered automatically.
You accept the academic offer and the scholarship offer separately; more information is provided with the scholarship offer letter.

ANU publishes a separate ANU International Achievement Award for applicants resident outside this award's country list, with published values of 20% for Undergraduate, 20% for Postgraduate, 25% for South East Asia and 50% for Pacific.
coverage: 20% off your first-year tuition fees, with the tuition scholarship applied towards tuition at the start of each semester.
One year of payments; ANU states the duration of the Award is one year.
requirements: There is no need to apply for the scholarship; all eligible students applying for admission to commence at the university will be automatically considered.
Press the 'Apply now' button to start the Admissions application process.
You will need to accept both your academic offer and your scholarship offer separately; more information is provided with your scholarship offer letter.
The recipient is responsible for making payment of all tuition fees by the prescribed date as set out by the University each session.
The value of the Award is stated in the letter of offer.
Only applicants who meet all the eligibility criteria will be considered.
ANU publishes a Conditions of Award document numbered 63/2026, linked from the scholarship page.
documents: No separate scholarship application or scholarship document is required; consideration is automatic with the admissions application.
The ANU admission application itself, submitted through the 'Apply now' button on the scholarship page.
The scholarship offer letter, which states the value of the Award and must be accepted separately from the academic offer.
application_method: Choose an eligible ANU program; the Doctor of Medicine and Surgery (MChD) and the Master of Digital Transformation and Entrepreneurship (MDTE) are excluded.
Press the 'Apply now' button on the scholarship page to start the ANU Admissions application process.
Submit the admission application; there is no separate scholarship application, and eligibility is assessed automatically.
Receive the academic offer and, if selected, a separate scholarship offer stating the value of the Award.
Accept the academic offer and the scholarship offer separately.
Pay your share of the tuition fees by the prescribed date set out by the University each session; the tuition scholarship is applied towards tuition at the start of each semester of the award year.
existing.selection_notes: ANU states that selection is based on academic merit, that only applicants who meet all the eligibility criteria will be considered, that qualifications submitted for admission will be converted to the common scale which determines whether an applicant is eligible, and that eligible applicants with multiple qualifications will be ranked according to the qualification used as the basis of admission. The value of the Award is stated in the letter of offer. ANU publishes no interview, no referee requirement, no offer rounds and no appeal process for this award.
existing.best_fit: International students resident in China (including Taiwan, Hong Kong SAR and Macau SAR), Japan, Mongolia, the Republic of Korea or the Democratic People's Republic of Korea who are applying for admission to an eligible ANU undergraduate, honours, graduate certificate or postgraduate coursework program, meet a Selection Rank of 85 or equivalent (undergraduate) or a GPA of 5.5 or equivalent (postgraduate), and are not already covered by external sponsorship of their tuition fees.
existing.notes: This is not full funding and should not be budgeted as such: the published value is 20% off first-year tuition fees for one year only, and recipients pay the balance of all tuition fees by the prescribed date each session. ANU states recipients are responsible for the costs of books, study materials, accommodation and all other costs of study. The award can be offered only once at each level of study, with two published exceptions: progression from an undergraduate degree (AQF Level 7) to a one-year Honours program (AQF Level 8), and packaged offers such as a Graduate Certificate leading to a Master's degree. Eligibility is by residential status, not citizenship, and is restricted to China (including Taiwan, Hong Kong SAR and Macau SAR), Japan, Mongolia, the Republic of Korea and the Democratic People's Republic of Korea; residents of all other countries apply to the separate ANU International Achievement Award. Holding external sponsorship covering all or part of your ANU tuition fees disqualifies you. Deferral, renewal, return-home obligations, clinical restrictions and tax treatment are not published on the page read; the Conditions of Award (63/2026) PDF is the document that governs them and could not be read.
existing.duration: Payment made for 1 year (payments are made for a fixed number of years; for this award that is one year)
existing.application_period: Continuous. ANU's scholarship page shows the application period as 'Open for applications' with no closing date, because no separate scholarship application is required: all eligible students applying for admission to commence at the University are considered automatically.
existing.deadline_display: Application period: Open for applications. ANU publishes no closing date for this award; consideration is automatic with the admissions application.
